headline: Data Scientist
company_hook: Creditspring is a UK-based, FCA-regulated consumer credit company focused on improving financial stability and resilience for its members through innovative financial products and services.

rephrase.az1: Built an LLM agent (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Claude Haiku 4.5) with three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation, and dataset provenance.
rephrase.az3: Deployed the agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda with ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles, and least-privilege policies.
rephrase.az4: Wrote a three-tier test framework (tool-level, API/integration, live agent) of ~65 tests across 8 files, validated after the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock.
rephrase.av4: Built a JavaScript web-scraping pipeline for automating manual data collection and surfacing market-trend signals for pricing decisions.
rephrase.p_gg2: Developed per-gene protein-prediction models using OLS and GPU Random Forest ensemble for 11,459 genes with resumable chunked GPU training.
rephrase.p_ch1: Created an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, with two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search and SMOTE for customer behaviour analysis.
